campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered changes to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for a resurfacing project, and an update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27. The Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund the replacement of remaining equipment, though details on that item were limited.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for a resurfacing project
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business along with two land-use appeals and final map approvals for property subdivisions. It also considered appeals of Planning Commission decisions on housing projects at 6th Street and Oak Place, and discussed options for law enforcement services ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Design Review and setback variance approval for a house and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Tentative Map and Design Review approval for a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered routine business including a wastewater treatment plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View, a two-year VTA Board reappointment, and several commission appointments. The Council also considered an interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention/custodial facility applications, along with an amendment to the city's legal services agreement and the Housing Element implementation schedule.
keyTopics: Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Councilmember Jonathan Weinberg's reappointment to the VTA Board for the north counties seat
Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention or custodial facility applications
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Amendment to the Berliner Cohen legal services agreement, raising the monthly retainer to $21,500

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council considered routine administrative matters, including approval of minutes from a prior meeting and the monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract actions, including amendments to agreements for services and an HVAC-related agreement, along with new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council and Closed Session meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026 (including a correction)
A Second Amendment to an existing agreement authorized for the Town Manager to execute
A First Amendment to an agreement for Heating Ventilation and Air (HVAC) services
New Professional Services Agreements authorized for the Town Manager to execute

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee reviewed the upcoming October 6, 2026 council agenda and confirmed the October 13 meeting is cancelled. The committee also considered several special event approvals, a council travel request, and three policy items on automated license plate readers and non-disclosure agreement transparency.
keyTopics: Approval of special events: a Councilmember Mulcahy-sponsored 'Conversations for Good 2026' event, a District 9 farewell celebration, and retroactive approval of the Golden State Valkyries flag raising
Council Transparency and Private Non-Disclosure Agreements, brought by Councilmembers Ortiz, Campos, Cohen, Candelas, and Casey
Two related items on Automated License Plate Readers: internal controls (Mayor, Foley, Candelas, Casey) and data access and safeguards (Kamei, Tordillos, Cohen, Mulcahy)
A joint special meeting agenda with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee
An update to the Public Safety, Finance and Strategic Support Committee's August–December 2026 work plan

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Council Sustainability Committee reviewed the city's draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan, which lays out strategies for reducing greenhouse gas emissions across Mountain View over the next five years. The committee also considered the 2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory, a report tracking the city's recent emissions levels.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council considered a five-year plan for addressing homelessness in the city, along with several contracts for city equipment and services, including recreation software, video conferencing systems, and a maintenance management system. The Council also took up budget and personnel matters, including special pay for a new police community crime reduction team, and discussed positions on upcoming state and local ballot measures.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contracts for city technology and infrastructure, including video conferencing equipment, UPS system upgrades, and a maintenance management system
Amendment to add special pay for police positions on a newly created Community Crime Reduction Team
Reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities for the US 101 Express Lanes project
Council positions on state and local ballot measures for the November 2026 election

cupertino.title: Cupertino Parks and Recreation Commission — October 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino Parks and Recreation Commission met to discuss a cybersecurity public awareness event. The agenda also included standard information about how members of the public could attend and comment on the meeting.
keyTopics: Cupertino Cybersecurity Public Awareness Event

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council considered a major housing proposal at 451-475 El Camino Real, including prezoning, a General Plan land use designation, annexation, and a subdivision map to allow 408 new residential units along with related site improvements. The Council also met in closed session to discuss ongoing and potential litigation, including a case involving the city's electric utility.
keyTopics: Public hearing on prezoning, annexation, and subdivision approval for a 408-unit residential development at 451-475 El Camino Real
Review of the project's Environmental Impact Report (EIR) prepared under CEQA
Closed session on existing litigation involving Silicon Valley Power, the Northern California Power Agency, and the California Department of Water Resources
Closed session discussion of anticipated litigation, including possible initiation of a new case

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council reviewed a draft housing and community development funding plan, discussed the city's red light camera safety program, and looked at the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also took up financial actions related to the former Redevelopment Agency's bond refinancing.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Condition assessment of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolutions related to the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency, including sale and issuance of refunding bonds

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission — September 22, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission considered proposed guidelines for using synthetic turf on playgrounds and reviewed a park improvements ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve improvement project. The meeting also included a council liaison update, a department report from staff, and updates from ad hoc committees and liaisons.
keyTopics: Proposed Playground Synthetic Turf Use Guidelines
Park Improvements Ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project (PE-21000)
Department report from staff
Ad hoc committee and liaison updates
Council liaison report
